AUTOANTHONYRELICS-ENABLED.title: Enable Anthony Algorithm - Relics
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-ENABLED.hover.desc: Master switch. When off: generated relics stop spawning, the reward pool returns to vanilla relics, and owned generated relics have no effect.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-REPLACE_VANILLA_RELICS: When on: vanilla relics are stripped from the run grab bag, so every reward source (combat, chests, shops, events) offers generated relics only. Ancients, starters, Neow and event-fixed relics are always untouched.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-ENABLE_EXTRA_EFFECT_PO: When on: generated relics may also roll card-level effects ported from Qurious Crafting Relics - give cards in your hand Retain / Sly / Ethereal, or enchant cards with Sharp / Nimble / Imbued. Off by default: vanilla relics never do this. MULTIPLAYER: this changes generation, so every player must use the same value.
Relative chance that a relic's on-trigger effect (damage, block, energy, draw, powers, downsides) is chosen. Only the ratio between the four weights matters; 100 each reproduces the default uniform draw.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-WEIGHT_PASSIVE_CORE.ho: Relative chance that a passive effect (hand-draw modifiers, restriction affixes) is chosen. Applies to the restriction-pair draw; the exhausted-pool fallback draw is always uniform. MULTIPLAYER: every player must use the same value.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-WEIGHT_BENEFIT_CORE.ho: Relative chance that a strictly-beneficial passive (Ancient benefit affixes) is chosen, when several are eligible. How OFTEN the benefit band appears at all is a separate, fixed rate. MULTIPLAYER: every player must use the same value.
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-WEIGHT_EXTRA.title: Weight: Extra Pool Effects
AUTOANTHONYRELICS-WEIGHT_EXTRA.hover.des: Relative chance that an extra-pool effect is chosen. Ignored while the extra effect pool is off. MULTIPLAYER: every player must use the same value.
